Naval-gray hull dominates the center, rust-red scaffolding wraps the hull, welding tarps hang still, chain hoists are visibly slack, and wet concrete channels run along the dock floor. Soldiers and engineers move calmly between scaffolds; one engineer holds a clipboard. No anomaly and no kaiju.

Routine work has advanced only slightly: the clipboard engineer has made a mark and lowered the pencil, two workers have moved one scaffold bay, and one welding tarp has shifted gently.
